Markus — thanks for sending the materials. Our counsel reviewed and returned a few redlines; attaching the redlined doc. High-level items:

- Clause 4.2 (Subprocessors): we asked for an explicit exception to notify us 30 days before onboarding a subprocessors that handle customer PII.
- Clause 7.1 (Data transfers): we suggested adding a fallback to SCCs and a commitment to use EU hosting where available for NovaStore accounts.
- Clause 9.3 (Liability cap): we proposed a modest increase tied to the initial 12-month fees for our category of customer.

Also flagged one subprocessor on your list (LogixData). Can you confirm whether LogixData handles decrypted customer payloads or only telemetry/metrics? If it handles payloads we will need the SOC 2 evidence for that vendor.

We attached our redline (Redline_NovaStore_20260404.docx). Happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Best,
Julia
